answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32840 Country: India Title: If i missed jamat, can we make our own jamat in same masjid? Question: If i missed jamat, can we make our own jamat in same masjid? Answer ID: 32840 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1089/1089/M=1432) The scholars of Fiqh have written that the second jama’ah in the portion of mosque is makrooh. ويكره تكرار الجماعة بأذان و إقامة في مسجد محلة (درمختار) If you miss your jama’ah, you can do second jama’ah in the exterior part of the mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
